$comment: Authoritative test manifest for AgentDev Lab. Any agent or CI job MUST run these commands verbatim. Commands are never to be weakened, narrowed, or replaced to make a run look better.

suites.description: Full unit and integration suite for the harness, including adversarial adapters and execution of every curated SQL analysis.
Harness self-validation: runs the noop and oracle controls over every registered task and asserts the expected pass/fail polarity.
Verifies that no task fixture, protected test file, or stored result has been tampered with.

gate.description: A milestone may only be committed when every authoritative suite exits 0.

setup.description: Verifies the environment and runs every authoritative suite. No installation required.
